summary: International General Insurance Holdings filed a Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter and first-nine-months 2026 unaudited results and declaring an ordinary common share dividend, the routine earnings-and-dividend update equivalent to a US current report with an earnings release exhibit. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated. Watch for dividend amount and record dates in the full release, plus continued reserve and combined-ratio trends after the Middle East war loss; no risk-arb angle exists.
